top_signals.title: China Materials Stocks Emerge From Slump as New Market Leaders
top_signals.summary: China’s materials stocks have surged to the top of the market over the past month, as rallies in gold and copper transformed one of this year’s lagging sectors into a market leader.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Japan’s inflation picks up, backing BOJ’s case for rate hike
top_signals.summary: The consumer price index excluding fresh food rose 1.8% in July from a year earlier, picking up from a 1.6% advance in the previous month.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Chinese startup rolls out robot arms in logistics warehouses
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: U.S. bond intervention is like 'paying your mortgage with your credit card,' JPMorgan's Sullivan says
top_signals.summary: The U.S. government's efforts to manage pressure in the Treasury market risk merely shifting the problem down the road, according to JPMorgan's James Sullivan.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
